decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - 1.	The rear portion of the existing single storey rear extension shall be demolished, leaving a depth of extension of 3.05m from the original main rear wall of the house on the southern boundary, and 4.05m from the original main rear wall of the house on the northern boundary within 3 months of the date of this permission, and a new rear wall with windows and door erected, in accordance with details shown on drawing no 2230/3 received 20.3.03
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the extension is occupied.

Condition : 4 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the side walls of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Retention of single storey rear extension and part demolition and alteration to rear flankwall.
